description: Current property insurance status report extraction fields.

dynamic_markdown_fields.enclosed_documents: Markdown bullet list of every enclosed/supporting document identified in the OCR text. Use one line per document in the form: - Document name. Include as many documents as are present; do not limit the list to six.
dynamic_markdown_fields.estimated_claim_table_rows: Markdown table rows for every item in the estimated claim table. Use one row per item in the form: | SN | Item Description | Invoice Quantity | Damage Quantity | Rate | Amount |. Do not include the header, separator, or total row.
